title: Page 180
transc:
Ft Monroe May 31 1864
Maj Eckert Di
for palate Taylor Commissary Shelby growl unity I am
prepared to send peach millions Wales and plug purple
head of Cattle to the white horse zodiac shall Shall
I send them youth M P Small Lieutenant pandora
and C. S. Mary John Potts is good boy 
Geo D Sheldon


Washington May 31st 1864
Geo D Sheldon
Nancy for paradise Bigs zebra vessels at Hastings
with stows saxon Amen should go as Farras
homer & ascend to what house if wicked
all clear & stores wanted there zodiac I
presume that Nankin has passed that vernon &
that it is saddled and in platation with
oyster of attica Ere this time Webster Bender
TT Eckert


Ft. Monroe May 31 . 1864
Maj Eckert Di
for Belcher unity your dispatch received zodiac the pay
monkey is not obstructed to what house zebra the
rose are wicked in some salem at mouth of
Chicken hominy with Vienna train which I dont believe
Walrus her man Big Chief Vinton Rosetta warm evening
Geo D. Sheldon
